_comment: General configuration for makato-plan plugin. All settings that influence skill execution and review output. Loaded by skills at runtime — changes take effect on next skill invocation.
_TeamSize_comment: Solo | Team. Solo: skip all ownership/team questions, generate numbered Markdown reviews only (no HTML). Team: full stakeholder identification, HTML interactive reviews.
_Status_comment: Development | Dev | Production | Prod. Development: skip deployment, rollout, migration, feature-toggle sections — plan technical solution only. Production: full pipeline including deployment planning.
_agents_comment: Runtime limits for sub-agents dispatched by skills. These control how much work each agent can do per invocation.

context-scout._comment: Read-only agent that scans context/ folders for files relevant to the current feature.
context-scout._tokenBudget_comment: Max tokens the scout can return per dispatch. Higher = more context but more cost. Range: 500–10000.

doc-writer._comment: Generates review documents (MD or HTML) and writes final markdown artifacts from structured input.
doc-writer._maxTurns_comment: Max LLM round-trips the agent gets to finish its work. 25 is enough for most artifacts. Range: 5–50.

dev-reviewer._comment: Lead Developer perspective in Three Amigos review — challenges feasibility, dependencies, estimates.
dev-reviewer._maxTurns_comment: Max LLM round-trips per review session. Range: 3–25.
dev-reviewer._maxFindings_comment: Max issues the reviewer can raise per story. Keeps reviews focused. Range: 1–10.

po-reviewer._comment: Product Owner perspective in Three Amigos review — challenges value delivery, scope, user outcomes.

qa-reviewer._comment: QA Engineer perspective — challenges testability, finds edge cases, drafts Gherkin scenarios.
qa-reviewer._maxGherkinScenarios_comment: Max draft Gherkin scenarios the QA agent writes per story. Range: 1–10.

prototype-builder._comment: Generates interactive single-file HTML prototypes from design context and UX decisions.
prototype-builder._maxTurns_comment: Higher limit because prototype generation is iterative (N+3 pass strategy). Range: 10–60.
prototype-builder._fileSizeWarningKB_comment: Warn when generated prototype exceeds this size in KB. Range: 100–2000.

brainstorming._defaultSessionDepth_comment: quick = ~15 min, 1 technique. standard = ~30 min, 2–3 techniques. deep = 60+ min, multiple techniques.

_toIssues_comment: Defaults for the to-issues skill (creates GitHub issues from stories.json). CLI flags override these.

toIssues._mode_comment: interactive = user confirms labels before each issue creation. autonomous = no prompts, all decisions applied silently.
toIssues._dryRun_comment: true = no actual GitHub issues created, synthetic issue numbers assigned. Useful for testing.
toIssues._ghHost_comment: GitHub host. Only github.com supported; enterprise hosts are blocked.

_issueToProject_comment: Defaults for the issue-to-project skill (syncs issues to GitHub Projects v2 board).

issueToProject._readyQueueMode_comment: manual = issues stay in Todo until explicitly moved. autonomous = no-label issues auto-promote to Ready.
issueToProject._skipVerify_comment: true = skip board ID probe on first call. Use only if probe causes errors.
issueToProject._webhookStrictLink_comment: true = non-actionable webhook events exit with code 1 instead of 0.
issueToProject._unknownRepoBehavior_comment: warn = log warning on unknown repos during reconcile. error = HALT with UNKNOWN_REPO.
issueToProject._autoReinit_comment: true = automatically re-initialize config when stale project config detected.

_storyConstraints_comment: Story point validation rules enforced by decompose and to-issues.

storyConstraints._maxStoryPoints_comment: Hard cap. Stories exceeding this with no safe split trigger a BLOCK error. Range: 1–21.
storyConstraints._validPointValues_comment: Fibonacci sequence. Off-scale values (e.g. 18, 21) trigger immediate BLOCK.

excalidraw._defaultOutputMode_comment: obsidian = .md file (Obsidian-compatible). standard = .excalidraw file. animated = .excalidraw with animations.
